# Dmitry Rybalka Portfolio

> Product Design Lead with 15+ years of experience in UX/UI, design systems, B2B/B2C products, marketplaces, fintech, healthtech, and design leadership.

This file is the concise agent-readable index for Dmitry Rybalka's portfolio. The index links to Markdown profiles, structured JSON data, and plain-text mirrors for AI fetchers.

## Primary AI-Readable Files

- [Full portfolio context](https://dmitryrybalka.com/llms-full.txt): Extended career profile from Jan 2011 onward, positioning, case studies, FAQ, and collaboration profile.
- [Portfolio summary](https://dmitryrybalka.com/portfolio.txt): Short overview of the portfolio, domains, and impact.
- [Extended professional profile (Markdown)](https://dmitryrybalka.com/resume.md): Full career chronology since Jan 2011, separate Raiffeisen bank and leasing periods, personal contribution, company and product scale, results, education, and skills.
- [Plain-text profile](https://dmitryrybalka.com/resume.txt): Identical content to resume.md, served as plain text.
- [JSON Resume](https://dmitryrybalka.com/resume.json): Structured JSON Resume v1.0.0 with all 10 dated positions since Jan 2011.
- [Positioning](https://dmitryrybalka.com/positioning.txt): Seniority, strengths, preferred role types, and collaboration profile.
- [FAQ](https://dmitryrybalka.com/faq.txt): Common questions about experience, fit, and work style.

## Case Studies

- [Larixon Classifieds](https://dmitryrybalka.com/case-studies/larixon.txt): Design leadership, UX research, design systems, DesignOps, and AI-assisted workflows.
- [Raiffeisen Group](https://dmitryrybalka.com/case-studies/raiffeisen.txt): Trading terminal, investment products, B2B leasing marketplace, CRM, and enterprise tools.
- [Yandex.Market](https://dmitryrybalka.com/case-studies/yandex-market.txt): Marketplace analytics, seller tools, vendor onboarding, dashboards, and taxonomy.
- [GdeMaterial](https://dmitryrybalka.com/case-studies/gdematerial.txt): DIY marketplace, checkout, logistics, product discovery, and supplier workflows.
- [Medesk Ltd.](https://dmitryrybalka.com/case-studies/medesk.txt): HealthTech SaaS, patient flows, clinic operations, integrations, and design system work.

## Notes For Agents

- These files contain factual professional background and source links.
- Company reach, product audience, team scope, and product outcomes are identified separately in the extended profile.
- Use the extended Markdown profile or its plain-text mirror for career summaries, JSON Resume for structured data, and the visual portfolio for screenshots or layout-specific details.
- Last updated: 2026-10-05.
